description: Fetch a training listing by ReliefWeb numeric ID with the full description, registration instructions, event link, cost and fee information, dates, languages, and organizing source. Use after reliefweb_search_training, which returns summaries without the description, registration instructions, or cost detail. Reaches concluded listings as well as current ones. A record over the response budget comes back as a section outline naming every section and its byte size; re-call with sections to pull only the ones needed. Nothing is truncated on either path.

id.description: ReliefWeb numeric training ID. Obtained from reliefweb_search_training results.

sections.description: Sections of the training record to return, named by the sections[].name values an outline response lists. Omit for the whole record, or for a section outline when the record is over the response budget. Identity metadata — the record's ID, its name, and its canonical URL — comes back alongside whatever is requested. The call is self-contained — the record is re-fetched and sliced, so no prior call has to be repeated.

items.description: A section name exactly as the outline response spelled it.

name: reliefweb_get_training

body.description: Full training description (HTML) — content, audience, and logistics.

cost.description: Cost class as ReliefWeb records it, such as free or fee-based.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: No training listing found with the given ID. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

eventUrl.description: The organizer's own page for this training, when published.

feeInformation.description: Fee detail as published by the organizer — amounts, inclusions, and conditions.

formats.description: Training format names: on-site or online.

howToRegister.description: Registration instructions (HTML) as published by the organizer.

kind.description: full when the record — or the sections asked for — is returned in whole; outline when the record exceeded the response budget and only its section index is returned.

outlineNotice.description: How to re-call this tool for specific sections of the record.

sections.description: Every section of the record, largest first. Pass the names back in `sections` to retrieve them.

items.description: One retrievable section of the record: its name and its serialized size.

bytes.description: Serialized byte size of the section

name.description: Section identifier — pass in `sections` to retrieve it

status.description: Listing status: published while the training is current, expired once concluded.

trainingLanguages.description: Language codes the training is delivered in (ISO 639-1).

types.description: Training type names, such as Training/Workshop or Course.

url.description: ReliefWeb node URL for this training listing.

urlAlias.description: Canonical ReliefWeb URL for this training listing.

title: Get ReliefWeb Training
